haiku.problem: Asks the baker to guess the next words of a line. The setup gives the first clause ('said in his heart he would ascend to the heavens') and 'What else did he say?' asks for the rest, which breaks the rule against guessing the next words of a line.

Misattributes the speech. Verse 15 is part of the song and does not say the LORD speaks it; the LORD's own words come later in verses 22-23. The question also calls the king 'proud,' which the verses don't state outright, though verses 13-14 imply it.
